title: Not very sturdy- yuck sticks to brush!!
text: Not very sturdy- yuck sticks to brush!!. I was looking for a small durable dustpan and brush… This fits the size, just not sturdy and durable. It will do the trick. Keep in mind the bristles are plastic or acrylic and tend to stick to things such as hair or fuzzies that you try and sweep up. Basically, you have to hand remove some of the yuck from the bristles after you using! The lan itself needs to be more sturdy- but, it was cheap and get a decent set for the easy sweep messes!
